title: Mechanism of heme binding by CP motifs in the BACH1 DNA-binding region
authors: Yubin Huang; Louise Fairall; Fred Muskett; Cyril Dominguez; Andrew Hudson; John W.R. Schwabe
one_liner_zh: 该文研究BACH1转录因子CP基序结合血红素的结构机制及其介导的DNA解离，虽涉及TF-DNA互作但核心是血红素结合而非DNA结合建模，且方法为光谱/NMR/结合实验，无AI或物理模拟方法。
abstract: BACH1 is a heme-regulated “basic-leucine-zipper” containing transcriptional repressor that binds its DNA recognition elements as a heterodimer with MAFK. Heme-binding is thought to be mediated by several cysteine-proline (CP) motifs and to trigger dissociation of the heterodimer from DNA. However, the structural basis of heme recognition and the mechanism of heme-binding and heme-mediated DNA dissociation remains unresolved. We have used UV-visible spectroscopy, 2D-NMR and DNA-binding assays to explore both heme-binding and DNA dissociation of a minimal BACH1 construct containing 2 CP motifs (C492(CP5) and C646(CP6)) flanking the DNA-binding domain. We find that heme is able to bind to both CP motifs, but also to other non-CP cysteines and histidines in the construct. Using NMR spectroscopy, we identify a structured binding pocket in which heme interacts with both C646(CP6) and Cys621. However, DNA-binding assays show that C646(CP6) is not required for heme-mediated DNA dissociation of the BACH1:MAFK heterodimer. Using UV-visible spectroscopy we show that C492(CP5) also recruits heme with a second ligand, a conserved histidine, H559, in the BACH1 DNA-recognition helix. Mutation of C492(CP5) reduces but does not abolish heme-mediated dissociation from DNA. Together, our findings reveal the structural basis for heme recognition by BACH1 and the mechanism, for heme-mediated dissociation from DNA.
abstract_zh: BACH1是一种受血红素调控的、含有“碱性亮氨酸拉链”的转录抑制因子，其与MAFK形成异二聚体并结合其DNA识别元件。血红素结合被认为由多个半胱氨酸-脯氨酸（CP）基序介导，并触发异二聚体从DNA上解离。然而，血红素识别的结构基础以及血红素结合和血红素介导的DNA解离机制仍未明确。我们利用紫外-可见光谱、二维核磁共振和DNA结合实验，探究了包含DNA结合域两侧两个CP基序（C492(CP5)和C646(CP6)）的最小BACH1构建体的血红素结合和DNA解离。我们发现血红素能够结合两个CP基序，也能结合构建体中其他非CP半胱氨酸和组氨酸。通过核磁共振波谱，我们识别出一个结构化的结合口袋，其中血红素与C646(CP6)和Cys621相互作用。然而，DNA结合实验表明，C646(CP6)并非血红素介导的BACH1:MAFK异二聚体DNA解离所必需。通过紫外-可见光谱，我们证明C492(CP5)也招募血红素，并伴有第二个配体，即BACH1 DNA识别螺旋中的保守组氨酸H559。C492(CP5)的突变减少了但未消除血红素介导的DNA解离。综合来看，我们的发现揭示了BACH1血红素识别的结构基础以及血红素介导的DNA解离机制。
